settings_theme_diag_alacritty_invalid.description: Error when an Alacritty config cannot be parsed. kind is YAML or TOML, detail is the parser's own message.

settings_theme_diag_alacritty_no_colors.description: Error when an Alacritty config holds no usable color.

settings_theme_diag_alacritty_no_colors_.description: Error when an Alacritty config has no colors section. [colors] is the section name.

settings_theme_diag_alacritty_not_mappin.description: Error when the top level of an Alacritty config is not a key-value mapping.

settings_theme_diag_appearance.description: Problem of a theme file: a theme's appearance is neither dark nor light, so it is skipped.

settings_theme_diag_base16_invalid.description: Error when a Base16 scheme cannot be parsed. detail is the parser's own message.

settings_theme_diag_base16_needs_base.description: Error when a Base16 scheme lacks the background (base00) or foreground (base05) color.

settings_theme_diag_base16_not_mapping.description: Error when the top level of a Base16 scheme is not a key-value mapping.

settings_theme_diag_config_cycle.description: Warning of a Ghostty import: a config-file include loops back on itself. config-file is the Ghostty setting.

settings_theme_diag_config_deep.description: Warning of a Ghostty import: config-file includes are nested too deeply.

settings_theme_diag_config_missing.description: Warning of a Ghostty import: an included config-file does not exist.

settings_theme_diag_file_object.description: Problem of a theme file: the top level is not a JSON object.

settings_theme_diag_file_unreadable.description: Warning of a package import: a file inside the archive or folder could not be read.

settings_theme_diag_font_object.description: Problem of a theme file: the font block is not an object. font is the JSON key.

settings_theme_diag_font_size.description: Problem of a theme file: the font size is not a number from 6 to 48.

settings_theme_diag_font_style.description: Problem of a theme file: font_style has another value.

settings_theme_diag_font_weight.description: Problem of a theme file: font_weight is not a number from 100 to 900.

settings_theme_diag_ghostty_no_settings.description: Error when a Ghostty config holds no setting Atlas can use. i18n-allow glossary:settings

settings_theme_diag_include_ignored.description: Warning of a VS Code import: a tokenColors entry points to another file, which is not followed.

settings_theme_diag_invalid_color.description: Warning of an import: a color value could not be read. key is the setting name in the source file.

settings_theme_diag_invalid_color_key.description: Warning of an iTerm import: a color entry could not be read. key is the entry name in the plist.

settings_theme_diag_invalid_option.description: Warning of a Ghostty import: a setting has a value Atlas cannot use. key is the setting name.

settings_theme_diag_iterm_invalid.description: Error when an iTerm colors file is not the expected property list.

settings_theme_diag_iterm_no_colors.description: Error when an iTerm colors file holds no usable color.

settings_theme_diag_name_missing.description: Problem of a theme file: a theme has no name and is skipped.

settings_theme_diag_needs_themes.description: Problem of a theme file: the themes array is missing.

settings_theme_diag_newer_version.description: Problem of a theme file: it was saved by a newer Atlas, so keys this one does not know are skipped.

settings_theme_diag_no_themes.description: Error shown for a theme file in a package that holds no theme.

settings_theme_diag_not_color.description: Problem of a theme file: a player color is not a hex color.

settings_theme_diag_not_color_ignored.description: Problem of a theme file: a color is not a hex color and is skipped.

settings_theme_diag_palette_entry.description: Warning of a Ghostty import: a palette line is not index=color. palette is the Ghostty setting.

settings_theme_diag_palette_range.description: Warning of a Ghostty import: Atlas uses the 16 ANSI colors only.

settings_theme_diag_players_shape.description: Problem of a theme file: players is not an array whose first item holds cursor and selection.

settings_theme_diag_store_no_ghostty_con.description: Error when the Ghostty config file to import does not exist.

settings_theme_diag_store_no_theme.description: Error when an action names a theme that does not exist.

settings_theme_diag_store_not_loaded.description: Error after an import: the file was written but the theme does not show up in the list. i18n-allow dnt:issue (the English means a problem, not a GitHub issue)

settings_theme_diag_store_shared_file.description: Error when removing a theme whose file holds other themes: Atlas does not rewrite the file.

settings_theme_diag_style_missing.description: Problem of a theme file: a theme has no style object and is skipped.

settings_theme_diag_style_object.description: Problem of a theme file: the style block is not an object. style is the JSON key.

settings_theme_diag_syntax_object.description: Problem of a theme file: the syntax block is not an object. syntax is the JSON key.

settings_theme_diag_syntax_role_shape.description: Problem of a theme file: a syntax entry is not an object with those three keys.

settings_theme_diag_syntax_role_unused.description: Problem of a theme file: a syntax role the editor has no use for is skipped.

settings_theme_diag_theme_not_found.description: Warning of a Ghostty import: the theme named in the config is not installed.

settings_theme_diag_theme_object.description: Problem of a theme file: an item of the themes array is not an object.

settings_theme_diag_unknown_key.description: Problem of a theme file: a key Atlas does not know is skipped.

settings_theme_diag_unrecognized_format.description: Error when the import cannot tell what format a pasted or chosen file is. name is the file name.

settings_theme_diag_vscode_invalid.description: Error when a VS Code theme cannot be parsed. detail is the parser's own message.

settings_theme_diag_vscode_no_colors.description: Error when a VS Code theme holds no usable color.

settings_theme_diag_vscode_not_object.description: Error when the top level of a VS Code theme is not a JSON object.
